negative_reviews.author: Iman Butt
negative_reviews.text: The food was delicious, the broth was rich and flavourful, the noodles were perfectly cooked and the steak was tender. Only reason why I didn’t give it a 5 star is due to the unwelcoming staff. As we went in a member of staff came to sit us down after a 5 mins wait and didn’t say hi or anything just asked if we had any allergies. We sat down with the menus and 20 mins later no one had come to us to ask if we had ordered or attempted to take our order. Flagging the servers down was basically impossible even though it was not that busy, as they all just avoid eye contact and just stood chatting to each other or slowly cleaning tables. But the food was good so we tried ignoring all that. In the end, after finishing our food a server came and took our dishes and asked if that was all or if we wanted to order anything else. We said no we’re done that’s all. We thought that was enough and she would come back with the card machine to take our payments like we had seen her do for other tables. But she just left us there for another 10 minutes till we flagged her down and payed. Why was it so hard for us just to pay for our food and get going.

deliveroo.source: Deliveroo_Master_Consolidation.xlsx — Weekly Summary. + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Manchester could not join the meeting because of a queue on site, so Amy Tang reported for it.
Sales were on target for a busy week with lots of £5 ramen.
Labour was on target, if a little higher, which is understandable with the volume of £5 ramen; food cost is also understandable because of the £5 ramen, which finishes this Saturday.
Spend per head was low because of the £5 ramen, although the team is pushing on it.

Reviews: one bad review, from last Monday or Tuesday, said the food was good but staff were not attentive or welcoming; the guests were not given a big welcome smile and were asked straight away whether they had a reservation.

The same guests waited 20 minutes after being seated with menus without anyone checking whether they were ready to order, even though the section had staff assigned, on a busy day with a queue outside.
After the check back and table clear the guests expected the bill to arrive, but the site brings the bill only when asked, which caused confusion.
The team has been made aware of a five second first impression standard for greeting every guest, busy or not, and this was agreed as a standard in the meeting; this is the only bad review so far.
Deliveroo: eight inaccurate orders, six disputed successfully; one customer could not find the broth (it was underneath) and one said the noodles were dry, and all have been disputed.
Rider wait time is still quite high but not too high; the team is working with the pass so the bag is handed to the driver immediately on arrival.

A discrepancy of 31 tonkotsu broths at Manchester was traced to the team forgetting to count the broth in use at the previous Sunday's stock take; the team did daily line checks last week, and Michael switched off all stock edits for this week's stock take to see accurate variances (Admin Meeting 26/10).

Region: the new Christmas set menu (including a set menu for large bookings) brings three new dishes; head chefs must check stock and have everything ready by Friday 30/10, leaflets must be ready by Friday (nudge marketing if they are late) and an allergy sheet is needed for the new dishes.
Region: the lunch deal continues through half term this week on a flexible basis, offered only when customers ask for it.
Region: the £5 ramen promotion ends on Saturday 31/10, and a new loyalty tier promotion will follow, probably announced at next Tuesday's KPI meeting.
Region: delivery prep times have improved overall across the region; this week's focus is disputing inaccurate orders as quickly as possible.
actions: Embed the five second greeting standard and regular table check ins on every shift - Owner: Manchester GM (03/11/2026)
Make sure riders are handed bags immediately by the pass to cut rider wait time - Owner: Manchester GM (03/11/2026)
Switch off all stock edits for this week's stock take so variances are accurate - Owner: Sophie Wang (03/11/2026)
Brief the head chef on the Christmas set menu and have all stock for the three new dishes ready - Owner: Manchester GM (30/10/2026)
Get the Christmas leaflets and the allergy sheet for the new dishes from marketing - Owner: Manchester GM (30/10/2026)
Dispute inaccurate Deliveroo orders as quickly as possible - Owner: Manchester GM (03/11/2026)
